_description: Domain-specific blind spots injected into fleet reviews and deep research when keyword triggers match. Each entry follows instinct-grade discipline: confidence, last_validated, failure_mode, decay_class. Source: claude-octopus blind-spot library pattern, adapted for Starfleet setup. Assimilation 2026-04-04.

entries.blind_spot: Supply chain attacks via compromised dependencies. Check: pinned versions? lockfile integrity? known CVEs in transitive deps? Pre/post-install scripts reviewed?

Prompt injection via hook additionalContext or user-supplied content stored in memory. Check: are inputs sanitized before injection? Could stored memories contain adversarial prompts? Is there a boundary between trusted and untrusted content?
entries.source: instinct-injector Unicode sanitization incident + mnemory boundary tags

entries.blind_spot: Secrets leaking into conversation context, K-LEAN entries, or auto-memory files. Check: does protect-secrets hook cover this path? Could subagents access credentials via cached files? Are secrets in env vars visible to hook child processes?

Hook-to-hook interaction via shared cache files. 63 hooks share files like session-checkpoint.json, metabolic-state.json, recent-actions.jsonl. Check: TOCTOU on shared files? Atomic writes (tmp+rename)? Stale state from previous session? Cross-hook ordering assumptions?
entries.source: Setup v3 TOCTOU fixes + adversarial review 2026-04-04

entries.blind_spot: Non-deterministic hook output breaks prompt caching. Hooks injecting timestamps, counters, or changing measurements via additionalContext change the conversation byte sequence, causing cache prefix misses. Check: is injected content deterministic? Could it vary between identical prompts?
entries.source: Reddit 7-layer token analysis Layer 4 + adversarial review

entries.blind_spot: Synthetic vs real rate limiting. Claude Code may fabricate client-side rate limits on large transcripts (model: '<synthetic>', zero tokens). Also: Extra Usage cache TTL downgrade from 1h to 5min. Check: is the rate limit genuine (has retry-after header)? Are we in Extra Usage mode?

Windows cp1252 vs UTF-8 encoding mismatch. Python on Windows defaults to cp1252, not UTF-8. JSON/JSONL files with non-ASCII characters (em dashes, smart quotes, emoji) will crash without explicit encoding='utf-8'. Check: all file opens specify encoding? MINGW64 HOME vs USERPROFILE path?

MCP servers that do startup health checks fail silently: no tools exposed, no error in Claude Code UI. Also: MCP connections can stall mid-session without detection. Check: is MCP_TIMEOUT set? Does the server have a health endpoint? Any heartbeat/liveness mechanism?
entries.source: n8n-ops MCP incident + mem0 MCP incident + claude-octopus heartbeat pattern
